selection_logic: Use breakthrough or working-cycle capacity for column sizing. Isotherm qmax is screening-only.

notes: No generic bed depth or EBCT is assumed.
required_inputs: flow; bed depth; particle size; EBCT; pressure drop; breakthrough criterion
selection_logic: Lead-lag is preferred where continuous treatment and breakthrough protection are required.
outputs: column count; service time; pressure drop

selection_logic: Keep media-capacity restoration, ion desorption and product recovery as separate efficiencies.
outputs: chemical demand; product composition; media lifetime
